info.title: B2B Quant & Regulatory Compliance APIs (@b2b-quant-apis)
info.description: Suite of 30 stateless B2B regulatory, tax, healthcare, environmental, financial, cybersecurity, KYB sanctions, and government procurement intelligence APIs across the US, EU, UK, and Brazil.

post.summary: Brazil Gov Procurement & Bidding Radar (PNCP API + MCP Server)
post.description: Extracts, filters, and enriches live Brazilian government public tenders (Pregão Eletrônico, Dispensa - Lei 14.133) from the official PNCP API with item-level pricing, ME/EPP flags, and LLM-ready RAG Markdown briefs. | PPE Event: `tender-analyzed` ($0.03 USD).
